sources.title: GUGiK 2024 3D buildings (LoD1)
sources.details: Automatic LoD1 flat roof at median ALS building-class points, ground at lowest building footprint/DTM intersection. Not full silhouette.

sources.title: GUGiK 1 m digital terrain model
sources.details: Acquired 2024-10-01. Native grid cropped to property and interpolated bilinearly; elevations in PL-EVRF2007-NH.

sources.title: GUGiK airborne LiDAR
sources.details: Acquired 2024-10-01. Class-6 building returns, maximum per native 1 m horizontal cell plus known controlling rays. Sparse samples are not a full surveyed silhouette.

sources.title: GUGiK buildings documentation / attribution
sources.details: Derived data: GUGiK. Source licence cited in source metadata: CC BY 4.0.

sources.title: Sternicza neighbourhood expansion
sources.details: 124 additional source footprints within 200 m nearest-footprint distance, processed 2026-11-13; official LoD1 ALS median heights, descriptive direction labels, and a retained source extract. The original site, buildings and analytical terrain are preserved. See data/sternicza-neighborhood-source.json.

limitations: Includes parcel 400 behind parcel 401; cadastral geometry does not verify ownership.
House floor (+1.2 m), eye levels, glazing, terrace, canopy and landscape are adjustable design assumptions, not a measured building survey.
Five apartment volumes are sampled. Coverage means blocked sample rays from one selected observer, not area percentage or a whole-garden privacy guarantee.
Hedges are ideal continuous opaque screens, not porous or tapered individual plants. Existing vegetation is not modelled.
PCK 3 returns above absolute elevation 24 m are isolated thin features of unconfirmed identity and excluded unless high features are enabled.
Farther blocks use median LoD1 roofs; their roof objects and true maxima may be higher.

The mapped own-house body blocks sightlines from outdoor observers. Indoor presets assume an open sightline through glazing; individual walls, window apertures and existing tree crowns are not surveyed analytical obstructions. Nearby mapped buildings are approximate flat-roof blockers.
Moving garden grade does not move the house floor. Existing hedge tops remain fixed when new planting is disabled.
A raised garden is a geometry experiment, not drainage, foundation or retaining-wall approval.

Expanded neighbourhood context uses 2024 source footprints and approximate LoD1 median roof bodies. Labels describe directions and distances, not verified postal addresses or current building condition. The separate 4 m surrounding terrain is for rendering only; the original analytical terrain remains unchanged.

benchmark.description: Critical sampled PCK 3 broad-roof ray from assumed seated living viewpoint, screen on boundary, original terrain.

contextTerrain.outside: Rendering only; clamp to context crop edge.
contextTerrain.resampling: Every fourth native 1 m grid centre; no property analytical grid cells are replaced.

labelsById.building-4: Building 4h · right/west neighbour · garden wall without windows

neighborhood.selectionMethod: All source building footprints touching a 200 m circle about the mapped house centroid; house and garage excluded from the surrounding list.
neighborhood.labelMethod: Descriptive street side, EPSG:2180 compass sector and centroid distance; these are not verified postal addresses.
neighborhood.heightMethod: Added bodies retain the official LoD1 base and ALS median height. Flat tops do not represent surveyed roof ridges or complete rooftop objects.
neighborhood.analysisScope: Existing five target sample sets stay unchanged. Added context bodies are real blockers and can be selected for a separate dense facade check.
neighborhood.terrainScope: Separate 4 m contextTerrain is for rendering only; the original terrain remains the analytical grid.

building-4.scope: Garden-facing east elevation of the building against the plot's physical right/west edge
building-4.note: The user confirms that this elevation has no windows into the garden. Suppress illustrative panes and all associated frames, mullions and sills on these wall segments. Other elevations remain illustrative; source footprints, elevations and analytical wall exposure stay unchanged.
